transcript.en: Good morning, and welcome to Oniton Hall, one of the largest estates in the area.
transcript.zh: 早上好，欢迎莅临这片区域最大的庄园之一Oniton Hall。

transcript.en: My name's Nick, and I'm one of the guides.
transcript.zh: 我是导游尼克。

transcript.en: I'll give you a brief introduction to the estate while you're sitting down, and then we'll walk round.
transcript.zh: 大家安顿好之后我会给大家简单介绍下庄园，之后陪大家一起逛逛。

transcript.en: The estate consists of the house, gardens, parkland and farm, and it dates back to the fourteenth century.
transcript.zh: 庄园由房屋，花园，邸园和农场组成，可以追溯到14世纪。

transcript.en: The original house was replaced in the late seventeenth century, and of course it has had a large number of owners.
transcript.zh: 原先的房子在17世纪末期被取代，当然它原来也曾被很多任房主所有。

transcript.en: Almost all of them have left their mark, generally by adding new rooms, like the ballroom and conservatory,or by demolishing others. The farm looks much as it's always done,
transcript.zh: 几乎所有的房主都留下了各自的印记，通常是增加了新的房间，比如舞厅和温室，或者拆除了其他房间，农场看起来还是和以前一样

transcript.en: although the current owner has done a great deal of work to the flower beds.
transcript.zh: 尽管现在的主人在花坛上做了大量的工作。

transcript.en: In the seventeenth century, the estate was owned by a very wealthy man called Sir EdwardDownes.
transcript.zh: 在17世纪，这个庄园归属于非常富有的爱德华唐斯先生。

transcript.en: His intention was to escape from the world of politics, after years as an active politician,
transcript.zh: 在活跃政坛数年之后，他打算远离政治世界，

transcript.en: and to build a new house worthy of his big collection of books,paintings and sculptures.
transcript.zh: 去建一个新房配得上存放他那一系列的藏书，油画和雕塑。

transcript.en: He broke off contact with his former political allies,and hosted meetings of creative and literary people, like painters and poets.
transcript.zh: 他和他之前的政治盟友毁约，然后主办了一些和富有创造力以及爱好文学的人一起的会议，例如画家和诗人。

transcript.en: Unusually for his time, he didn’t care，whether his guests were rich or poor, as long as they had talent.
transcript.zh: 和那时期的其他人不一样，他不在乎，他的门客是否贫穷还是富裕，只要有才华就可以。

transcript.en: Big houses like Oniton had dozens of servants until the 1920s or 30s,
transcript.zh: 直到20世纪二三十年代，像Oniton这样的大房子都有很多佣人，

transcript.en: and we've tried to show what their working lives were like.
transcript.zh: 我们尝试去展示他们的工作生活是什么样的。

transcript.en: Photographs of course don't give much of an idea, so instead, as you go round the house,you'll see volunteers dressed up as nineteenth-century servants, going about their work.
transcript.zh: 当然照片不会给你太多的想法，因此取而代之的是当你围着屋子参观的时候，你就能看到很多志愿者装扮成19世纪的佣人在工作的样子。

transcript.en: They'll explain what they're doing, and tell you their recipes, or what tools they're using.
transcript.zh: 他们会给解释他们在干什么，告诉你他们的方法或者他们在使用的工具是什么。

transcript.en: We've just introduced this feature to replace the audio guide we used to have available.
transcript.zh: 我们以这样的形式进行介绍来代替原来我们提供的音频导览。

transcript.en: I see there are a number of children here with you today.
transcript.zh: 我看今天好多人都是带着孩子一起来的。

transcript.en: Well, we have several activities specially for children, like dressing up in the sorts of clothes that children wore in the past,
transcript.zh: 我们为孩子提供了一些特别的活动，比如像穿过去小孩穿的各种各样款式的衣服，

transcript.en: and as it's a fine day, some of you will probably want to play in the adventure playground.
transcript.zh: 当天气好的时候，你们可能还想要去冒险乐园玩。

transcript.en: Our latest addition is child-sized tractors, that you can drive around the grounds.
transcript.zh: 我们最新增设了儿童拖拉机，你可以开着转几圈。

transcript.en: We'll also be going into the farm that's part of the estate, where there's plenty to do.
transcript.zh: 我们也会去庄园里的农场，那也有很多事可以做。

transcript.en: Most of the buildings date from the eighteenth century,
transcript.zh: 那的大部分建筑都建于18世纪，

transcript.en: so you can really step back into an agricultural past.
transcript.zh: 因此你能真实地步入农业的过去。

transcript.en: Until recently, the dairy was where milk from the cows was turned into cheese.
transcript.zh: 直到最近，乳品加工厂是将奶牛产的牛奶加工成奶酪的地方。

transcript.en: It's now the place to go for lunch, or afternoon tea, or just a cup of coffee and a slice of homemade cake.
transcript.zh: 你现在可以去那里吃午餐或者是下午茶，亦或者只是去喝杯咖啡吃块手工蛋糕。

transcript.en: The big stone building that dominates the farm is the large barn, and in here is our collection of agricultural tools.
transcript.zh: 在农场中最明显位置的大石头建筑是大谷仓，那有我们收集的农耕工具。

transcript.en: These were used in the past to plough the earth, sow seeds, make gates, and much more.
transcript.zh: 那些工具原来是用来犁地，播种，建门或做其他的事。

transcript.en: There's a small barn, also made of stone, where you can groom the donkeys and horses, to keep their coats clean.
transcript.zh: 这还有一个也是用石头建的小畜棚，在那你可以给驴和马梳毛，让他们的皮毛保持干净。

transcript.en: They really seem to enjoy having it done, and children love grooming them.
transcript.zh: 它们很享受这个过程，孩子们也喜欢给它们梳毛。

transcript.en: The horses no longer live in the stables, which instead is the place to go to buy gifts,books, our own jams and pickles, and clothes and blankets made of wool from our sheep.
transcript.zh: 马不再住在马厩里，取而代之的是一个可以买东西的地方，这有礼物，书，我们自己做的果酱和腌菜，以及一些用我们自己养的羊剪下的羊毛制作的一些服装和毯子。

transcript.en: Outside the shed, which is the only brick building, you can climb into a horse-drawn carriage for a lovely, relaxing tour of the park and farm.
transcript.zh: 在唯一一个砖棚的外面，你可以坐进一辆四轮马车去享受一段愉快且放松的公园和农场之旅。

transcript.en: The carriages are well over a hundred years old.
transcript.zh: 马车都是有百年的历史了。

transcript.en: And finally, the parkland, which was laid out in the eighteenth century, with a lake and trees that are now well established.
transcript.zh: 最后，有湖和树的邸园是在18世纪被设计到现在被建成。

transcript.en: You'll see types of cattle and sheep that are hardly ever found on farms these days.
transcript.zh: 在这里你能看到这些天在农场看不到的一些种类的牛和羊。

transcript.en: We're helping to preserve them, to stop their numbers falling further.
transcript.zh: 我们正帮着去保护它们，去阻止它们数量的减少。

transcript.en: OK, well if you’d like to come with me …
transcript.zh: 好的，如果你想跟着我的话...
